dead_ends: validate_pwml on the repo's structure signature alone fails every offline export (<pwc-id>, <short-name>, <pwbs-id> missing): writer.py leaves these out unless the PathBank DB supplied them, so they are counted, not errors.

A strict per-format entity and compartment equality fails on every run with a transport or interaction. First-pass probe classes, each traced to documented exporter behaviour and turned into a named 'known' class instead of a failure: PWML wraps a bare protein enzyme in '<protein> complex' (Stage 6, pipeline/entity_identity.py); the PathBank Unknown sentinel protein is not an entity in the clean model (SBML, KGML); PWML withholds interactions it cannot store (ir.processes.interactions[].withheld; the check reads that record, so without pwml_ir the same pairs are failures); a reaction's regulator is a modifier in SBML but an interaction with the enzyme complex in PWML; SBML puts an entity with no stated location in 'unspecified location' while PWML and SBGN place it; PWML merges compartments under canonical names and places the ends of the interactions and transports it draws.
open_questions: Known classes d (PathWhiz wrapper), e (PWML-withheld interactions), f (Unknown sentinel, unplaced entities), g (modifier interactions) and h (extra PWML placements) go beyond the a/b/c classes in the brief. Each rests on code (pipeline/entity_identity.py, pwml/ir.py withheld record, clean_model/builder.py, writer.py), but the 97-run proof was not run, so how many failures remain after them is unknown.
